create_AttrDict: create an AttrDict instance with key-value pairs for configuration options
access_AttrDict_attribute: access an AttrDict value using dot notation instead of bracket notation
set_AttrDict_attribute: set a new attribute on an AttrDict using dot notation assignment
lock_AttrDict_immutable: lock an AttrDict and all nested AttrDicts to prevent further modifications
check_AttrDict_is_immutable: check whether an AttrDict is currently locked as immutable
